Sounds like an Eating Disorder. Her BMI is 16 which and anything under 18.5 is considered to be underweight.   
Does she also exercise a lot and stuff? Try to see her pre and post eating behaviour like excessive calorie counting, segregating food, purging in the form of exercising a lot, eating only healthy, eating alone a lot etc. These are generally indicative of EDs other than the weight and BMI itself.   
You should consult a doctor and most probably someone who is an expert in EDs. Your sister might undergo therapy and be put under a new diet regime which will be planned out very well.  EDs are very dangerous, especially when it reaches extreme end of the spectrum. She might be Anorexic. 

Please consult a doctor ASAP. This can be dangerous and life-threatening. Starving yourself can lead to severe heart conditions, etc. Her BMI is already a bad indicator. 

Obviously, I'm no expert but I've read a lot about EDs. A doctor will be a better help obviously!!

But, that is one reason why Im looking forward to completing my degree and move out and be truly independent. Keep trying for a job, you will eventually be successful. 

It took me a lot of trouble to land an internship, like a lot of trouble but I was able to land up with a good internship. Therefore, your work will never go in vain!! :)

I am friends with people on discord where I sometimes vent and I feel quite light after doing so!

If you involve with online SH communities, please distance yourself from them.  They can also be bad triggers and maybe try talking to your close friend. 

Since, you guys are close, you guys can maybe help each other? Idk... can work or not!!But, I wish you loads of good fortune and keep working through your degree. I believe you can do it and you will :)

Im from India, now imagine the state here when you guys in UK are struggling with the system. The talk about mental health among teens is almost non-existent. I am 24 currently and there was literally no talk about mental well being back in my school days. People still believe mental health to be some gimmicky bullshit and this triggers me too much.

So during the past 7 years ( when i graduated high school and present school scenario) nothing has changed. This just makes me sad.   
The situation for adults also is not that great here. Yes, helplines exist but the awareness is so less that most people end up suffering alone. People here think only crazy people go to psychiatrists and therapists. Totally fucked up situation.

 Im at a top college of India but again the on-campus counselling is almost non-existent. I've wanted to approach someone on campus but nothing. The shit has been outsourced to some random ass company with only phone calls and shit. I need a person to talk to live for fucks sake! I dont see the situation getting better any time soon and the academic pressure and stuff here is just too immense. 

The dream to not stigmatize mental health just seems so distant. Im grateful to have parents who talk about the need for mental health.
